text: Our big six person tent leaks at the top where the poles cross. Happened in two storms now.
Bought the air mat a while back. The little valve came right off in my hand on day two of a trip. Not happy, I slept on the ground.
Liquid fuel stove flares up badly when priming. Is it safe to keep using?
Self inflating mat doesn't self inflate much any more and slowly goes soft overnight.
Integrated stove system, igniter sparks but the burner doesn't catch unless I hold a lighter to it.
Inner door zip on the winter tent is stiff and has started to split.
Front pocket zipper pull snapped off my 22L daypack.
Shoulder strap adjuster on the women's 40 litre pack keeps slipping, I have to retighten it every hour.
Trail runners are too narrow for me. Do you have a wide fit?

Hi, I used the two person backpacking tent for the first time last weekend and water came in along the floor seam on the door side. It rained most of the night but nothing extreme. Is this normal or is the tent faulty?
The Insulated Air Mat I bought for my son loses air through the valve. Please advise how to get a refund.
Ordered the ultralight 2 person tent and tracking hasn't moved since it left the warehouse.
The men's leather boots run at least half a size small. Can I swap for a 10.5 even though I wore them around the house?
Sole is separating from the upper at the toe on my winter boots already.
Stitching is coming apart under the arm on the synthetic insulated jacket.
We received the 4 person family tent and the footprint together but there were only two of the long poles in the tent bag, should be three.
The pop up tent is fine for festivals but it let in a lot of water the first time it actually rained.
The canister stove won't light with the built in igniter any more. It clicks but no flame. Matches still work.
Bought the 30 litre daypack but it's bigger than I expected. Can I swap it for the 22 litre one?
Is the new down jacket back in stock? Your site says ships in 2 days but I've waited a week.
Main zip on my women's waterproof jacket separates from the bottom when I pull it up.
Cook set arrived but the box was crushed and the lid is dented.
The hip belt buckle on my 65 litre pack cracked on a cold morning. The pack is not very old.
New 3 person backpacking tent, the Mk II one. The fly is dripping at the vent after an hour of rain.
Pack of tent stakes says 12 but there were 10 in the bag.
My insulated air mat went flat twice in one night. I can't find a hole. The valve feels loose when I press it. I saw something online about a recall?
I ordered the 20 degree down bag, the new version, but the box had the synthetic 30 degree one in it.
I ordered a men's waterproof jacket and a merino top. Got two merino tops, no jacket.
